from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class RevenueReport(BaseModel):
    """Captures the operating revenue data for a single company in one document."""
    company_name: str | None = Field(description="The name of the company as reported in the document")
    stock_code: str | None = Field(description="The stock code of the company, if available")
    operating_revenue: float | None = Field(description="The operating revenue amount reported for the period")
    currency: str | None = Field(description="The currency unit of the revenue amount, e.g. Yuan")
    period: str | None = Field(description="The reporting period covered by the data, e.g. 2025-Q1")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    reports: list[RevenueReport]
